io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.widgets

Class GuideWidget

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.widgets.GuideWidget

  • public final class GuideWidget
extends java.lang.Object
    A functional guide screen an addon registers so the core guide embeds it as a dedicated entry on both layouts (classic + categorized), instead of the addon injecting its own category/custom layout. Meant for genuinely functional UIs (e.g. an advancement tree), NOT item browsing - items are always listed under the shared categories.

        Creates a widget bound to one addon's guide menu.
        Parameters:
        addon - The addon whose menu carries this widget, or null for the guide's main menu
        category - The guide category that shows this widget in the categorized layout. null keeps it out of that layout entirely: a categorized view has no addon menu to attach it to, so an uncategorized addon widget has nowhere to live.
